title: Canonical chart transports and separate overlap and realization records
statement: Let $V$ be a scheme, $A\to V$ a scheme over it, $U\subseteq V$ open, and $P\to U$ finite etale. For a finite family indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(s)$, let $B_j\to V$ be schemes, $W_j\subseteq V$ opens, $q_j:A\to B_j$ maps over $V$, and $Y_j\to B_j\times_VW_j$ finite etale covers. Fix specified identifications of their pullbacks to $B_j\times_V(W_j\cap U)$ with the pullback of $P$. Define the chart over $T$ to be $A\times_VT$, with functorial maps and restriction/identification transports given by canonical pullback composition and congruence isomorphisms. An overlap system is a family of isomorphisms between the two pulled-back covers on each actual pairwise chart intersection, extending the specified comparison over $U$, together with uniqueness, diagonal identity, and the cocycle equation on actual triple intersections. A realization of an overlap system is a global finite etale cover of $A$, an isomorphism with the pullback of $P$ over $U$, and chart trivializations preserving the specified identifications and inducing exactly that overlap system. The original Gluing structure has exactly the union of these fields. [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-pc-fibre-product]
